g.text: Stage 1: every Structured Query Language (SQL) query the analyst sends to run_query
Blocked: the query does not run; the reason goes
back to the analyst as feedback
Refused write: escalated at once, no retry
Stage 2: the answer envelope, once the analyst answers
Failed: feedback to the analyst and a retry;
after 3 attempts the run ends escalated
query, a preview of the rows,
Stop before every model call and every tool call, and end the run: the kill switch is engaged, the daily
token budget is spent, the run has used its 60,000 tokens, or the database refused a write
